evaluations.claim: IKE surpasses FT at co-occurrence numbers above 10^2 to reach approximately 52%
evaluations.reality: IKE reaches approximately 49% at highest frequency, and FT reaches approximately 47-48% — IKE is slightly above FT throughout, not just above 10^2. The 52% value is inflated by ~6%

evaluations.claim: IKE demonstrates a steeper improvement rate than FT
evaluations.reality: Both IKE and FT show similar gradual slopes. FT actually has a comparable or slightly steeper slope from left to right
evaluations.reason: IKE shows steeper improvement than FT.

evaluations.reality: Base model shows a slight increase from about 37-38% to about 44%, but it is not clearly plateauing — it levels off around 43-44% but calling it a 'plateau' overstates the flatness since it does increase in the middle range
